quarterly_data.quarter: JCET results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Board secretary and vice president Yuan Yan (2025 annual and Q1 2026 results briefing): JCET's 2025 revenue related to its advanced packaging business reached RMB 270 hundred million, a record high. Yuan Yan and CEO Zheng Li said the company's capital spending and R&D intensity in advanced packaging are rising markedly year by year and will support fast growth in related capacity and revenue over the next few years.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 advanced packaging revenue RMB 270 hundred million (record)

quarterly_data.quarter: JCET results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CEO Zheng Li (2025 annual and Q1 2026 results briefing), asked about the ramp of the new Jiangyin and Lingang plants: the company is speeding up the volume ramp of products at JCET Microelectronics' wafer-level microsystem integration high-end manufacturing project; the Shanghai Lingang automotive-grade chip packaging-and-test project has been formally put into use, and production projects for several domestic and overseas automotive chip customers (not named) are actively advancing product qualification and mass-production introduction.
